candidates.title: Draft booking and status notifications

demandEvidence.chore: Automate booking confirmations and provider assignment, payment status updates, and customer alerts for an on-demand service application.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: booking confirmations, provider assignment notifications, payment status updates, and customer alerts

ease.reason: A beginner can prototype a booking confirmation from fictional events; no supplied implementation reference supports integrations or notifications.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: operators of on-demand service apps may pay for reliable notifications; this request shows no buying intent or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can process sample bookings and draft status alerts; live API access, retries, and duplicate prevention are unverified.

autonomy.reason: The proposed event-to-alert loop is repeatable, but no supplied reference supports execution and a person must verify payment state and failures.

evidence.reason: The retained post spans state booking, assignment, payment-status, and alert tasks, but give no data schema, recurrence evidence, or corroboration.

candidates.reason: A narrow fictional-data notification prototype can be scoped from the stated task, but no implementation reference supports the mechanics; the honest provisional mean is below the threshold.

rejected.title: AI is coming for accounting after coding
rejected.reason: The post warns that an accounting module reached about 95% accuracy, but supplies no concrete requested chore or task to automate; inventing an accounting duty would exceed the evidence.

rejected.title: Show HN: flint - SSH and SFTP client built with GPUI
rejected.reason: The maker says they built an SSH/SFTP alternative and want to show it; the post provides no concrete requested service chore or specific task for a proposed student experiment.

rejected.title: Show HN: I built a tool to audit Shopify stores for AI agent and Google Shopping
rejected.reason: The title identifies a tool and broad audit purpose but gives no concrete audit checks, input, output, or separate user chore; proposing an automation task would invent missing requirements.

rejected.title: Email Sortierung -IMAP-Problem
rejected.reason: The retained spans describe one user's broken Code/IF-node email sorting workflow and request configuration help, a one-off bug report. A general sorting service would extend beyond that evidence; a prior writer assessment also found no supplied implementation support.

rejected.title: Show HN: I built this ASO tool to help you get more users for your iOS apps
rejected.reason: Only a maker title is retained: it names an ASO tool and broad goal but no concrete task, inputs, process, or results. An AI listing service would require invented duties and scope.

steps.message: Assessed all six assigned discussion identities. One concrete booking-notification task was scored as a proposed sample-data experiment and remains below threshold; five posts lack an eligible bounded chore or are a one-off troubleshooting report. No post proposed.
